formattedAddress: 10351, Taiwan, Taipei City, Datong District, Jianming Village, Huayin St, 69號1樓

displayName.text: Goodmauii 古茂宜咖啡 台北站前店

text.text:
Super nice and friendly staff, very attentive throughout the visit.
The coffee was excellent — you can really taste the quality of the beans.

The kimchi pork wrap was very tasty. The wrap was crunchy and smelled great, and all the ingredients were in a perfect combination. Everything was just right.

The Chestnut Mont Blanc was not too sweet and had a very good chestnut flavour. Really enjoyable overall.

text.text:
We stopped here for brunch and were quickly seated after waiting a bit in the waiting area (nice to have in the heat, given the small space). The location is directly across from the J5 entrance to the Q square mall.

The staff are attentive and were willing to help directly order (instead of through QR code) when my phone was being slow. They have menus in English and Chinese, where the QR menu is in English.

The decor and seating are comfortable and my family commented on the artistic thoughtfulness of it all, including the cutlery and dishware.

For food, we especially appreciated the flavors of the Maui coffee - deep, nutty and the caramel sea salt coffee (hot) - slightly but not too sweet. The steaming mushroom salad was very fragrant and the chicken salad had a hefty amount. Note that there are hard Edamame (which may be hard on teeth). The crepe was flavorful and an option for something lighter, thought I'd probably opt for others next time. Thank you!

text.text:
If you’re a coffee lover in Taipei, this spot should absolutely be on your radar. From the moment I walked in, the inviting aroma of freshly roasted beans hinted that something special was brewing.

The ambiance is relaxed and welcoming — ideal for enjoying a slow morning cup, catching up with a friend, or even getting some work done. Add to that a selection of tasty pastries that pair perfectly with the coffee, and you’ve got a café that’s truly worth revisiting.

text.text:
This place caught my eye on my way to check into my accommodation, and so I’ve made a mental note to come check it out as soon as I got the chance to do so. Absolutely love the contemporary, clean line decor inside and out. It’s a great place to chill, with or without company.

I ordered one of their popular (marked with a thumbs up in the menu) brunch dishes, Sous-vide Chicken Breast with egg, salad, and French toast. Plus an order of the Milk Cap Peach Oolong. the drink, while visually appealing with the froth on top, was just a tad bit too sweet for my taste. Chicken breast was tender and moist. Salad dressing was also a tad too sweet for me. Overall, it’s on the pricier side for Taiwanese standard, but I can see the appeal for younger demographics and especially tourists (being next to the Taipei Station). I’d return to try other dishes!

Best coffee I had in Taiwan. Their specialty iced coffee includes some ice cubes made out of that same coffee!

The breakfast chicken platter was also really good. Wish their mushroom egg sandwich wasn’t sold out cause it looked good
